system.name: Rippers — Harvested Hoplospheres
system.description: The Lodge’s harvested-hoplosphere economy for Rippers Unmasked. Aspects are essences; shards refine into spheres; matrices set banes; remnants set accessories. Source-faithful to the hoplosphere-economy brief; no invented rules values (⚠ owed markers where TFA mechanics belong). The Susurrus gathering environment is not yet authored (features.gathering off) — its element shape needs a live populated-gathering export; Susurrus material still flows through the shard components. Search TODO for tunable starting values.

essenceDefinitions.name: Algor
essenceDefinitions.description: The ice register. Lodge term for the aspect that presents as cold. From algor mortis, the cooling of a corpse.

essenceDefinitions.name: Sordes
essenceDefinitions.description: The poison register. Street counterpart: the crust. From sordes, the foul crust on a fever patient’s lips.

essenceDefinitions.name: Inanition
essenceDefinitions.description: The dark register. Street counterpart: the hollow. From inanition, death by emptiness.

essenceDefinitions.name: Empyreuma
essenceDefinitions.description: The fire register. Street counterpart: the scorch / burnt batch. From empyreuma, the burnt smell of organic matter spoiled by heat in a retort.

essenceDefinitions.name: Susurrus
essenceDefinitions.description: The air register (wave-2 material). Street counterpart: the whisper. From susurrus, a sound heard on auscultation.

essenceDefinitions.name: Residuum
essenceDefinitions.description: Refuses to refine. Over-differentiated material the Lodge’s categories cannot resolve. Has no sphere and no conversion rate — never a reagent (brief §6).

essenceDefinitions.name: Shard
essenceDefinitions.description: Shared tag carried by every aspect shard so a recipe can require "any N shards" regardless of aspect.

recipeItemDefinitions.name: Recipe: Setting — Melmoth
recipeItemDefinitions.description: Fabricate recipe card. Accessory setting (worked example, the better template). The broadsheet + 3 Susurrus shards + a phial, on the bench. Custom off-table Quality — a remnant that isn’t a body part is where the setting gets to say something.

recipeItemDefinitions.name: Recipe: The Scorch
recipeItemDefinitions.description: Fabricate recipe card. Street work. 2 shards of ANY aspect + scrap glass, in the street crucible. Routed by check into Ruined / Crude / Sound — pick the result option matching an EXTERNAL FU check (macro-driven; TODO(V3): native check tier bands, §9#5). Ingredients consumed on failure. A Crude sphere can never coagulate.

components.name: Clotted Remains (Algor)
components.description: GM-dropped on a kill. Rendered with a blade into shards of its aspect. Progressive salvage: one render run yields 1–2 shards (1d2) — the single number that tunes the whole economy (start low and let them complain; the GM raises the formula as the campaign loosens).

components.name: Slag
components.description: Ruined street work. What a failed Scorch leaves. Ingredients are consumed on failure.

components.name: Harvested Remnant
components.description: Remnant (accessory seed). The case-specific object a Quality is set from — GM-assigned per accessory; not always a body part. The remnant selects the Quality (brief §5.1). Best template: a remnant that isn’t a body part (§5.2).

components.name: Hyde Sinew
components.description: Remnant (worked example). Transformed sinew that does not relax after death. Sets Weapon Up (melee). The tutorial fight hands it over.

components.name: Melmoth Broadsheet
components.description: Remnant (worked example). The broadsheet that libelled the man — not anything off the creature, because the Wanderer is made of the lie. Its Quality goes custom rather than table.

tools.label: Lodge Bench
tools.name: Lodge Bench
tools.description: Tool (catalyst). The licensed bench. Set Immune — never breaks. Required present for Fixation, Decoction, Investiture and Setting; not consumed. A bench requires a Lodge subscription (brief §5).

tools.label: Street Crucible
tools.name: Street Crucible
tools.description: Tool (catalyst). The street crucible. Breakable. Required present for The Scorch; not consumed by the recipe, but may shatter in play (GM-adjudicated).
